title: Crops+
description: Crops+ is a prerequisite mod required to add any additional crops.
body:
# 🌾 Crops+ | The "Zero-Waste" Modular Framework

**Crops+** is a lightweight, high-performance library mod built for players who demand a clean, organized, and truly modular Minecraft experience. It serves as the core foundation for a series of independent crop and food expansions, ensuring perfect compatibility with **zero unnecessary items.**

---

### ✨ Core Philosophy: Pure Modularity

*   **🧩 True Pick-and-Choose:** You have total control. Mix and match any mods from the Crops+ ecosystem (Cucumber, Tomato, etc.) without worrying about duplicate items or "junk" ingredients cluttering your inventory.
*   **🌍 Global Localization:** Built-in automatic support for **7 major languages**: English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Russian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), and German. 
*   **⚙️ Seamless Integration:** Handles all complex backend logic, allowing sub-mods to remain small, fast, and focused on their specific content.

---

### 🚀 Future-Proof Versioning

We are starting our journey with **Minecraft 1.20.1**, but we don't plan to stop there! 
*   **Broad Compatibility:** While currently optimized for 1.20.1, we are actively working to expand support to **newer Minecraft versions** as they release, as well as considering **older stable versions** based on community demand. 
*   **Consistent Experience:** No matter which version of Minecraft you play, Crops+ will provide the same stable and clean foundation for your farming needs.

---

### 📦 Mandatory Requirement
This is a **Library Mod**. It does not add content by itself. It is **REQUIRED** for all modular expansions within the Crops+ ecosystem, such as:
*   🥒 **Cucumber Mod**
*   🍅 **Tomato Mod**
*   *...and many more to come!*

---

### 🌐 Supported Languages
English / 日本語 / 简体中文 / Русский / Español / Português / Deutsch

---

### 🛠️ Technical Info
*   **Platform:** Fabric
*   **Current Primary Version:** 1.20.1 (More versions coming soon!)
*   **Dependencies:** Fabric API (Required)
